note: _et elegit rex ex amicis suis Bacchidem_ (…) _et misit eum_, [ut videret exterminium quod fecit Iudas: sed] _et Alcimum impium constituit in sacerdotium_ – and the king chose one of his friends, Bacchides, (…) and sent him [to see the havoc that Judas has made] and the wicked Alcimus he appointed priest. The words between bracktes are in the Clementina, but not in Weber/Gryson and NVg.
